indicators.label: Religion-response denominator
indicators.description: People in the SIDRA religion table after excluding Sem declaração. The 2022 denominator is limited to people aged 10 years or older.
indicators.method: For 2000 and 2010, SIDRA table 137 variable 93 category Total minus Sem declaração. For 2022, SIDRA table 9537 variable 140 category Total minus Sem declaração.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Brazil federative units on IBGE 2022 boundaries
indicators.quality_notes: The 2022 wave changes the age universe to people aged 10 years or older; 2000 and 2010 cover resident population.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the religion-response denominator not in the Sem religião category.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Brazil federative units on IBGE 2022 boundaries
indicators.quality_notes: This is a non-no-religion share among responses with a religion-table category, not a harmonised denomination series. The 2022 age universe is not the same as the 2000/2010 universe.

indicators.label: No religion %
indicators.description: Share of the religion-response denominator in the Sem religião category.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Brazil federative units on IBGE 2022 boundaries
indicators.quality_notes: The source category label is Sem religião in all three built waves.

visual_layers.label: Religious affiliation %
visual_layers.notes: The 2022 wave is people aged 10 years or older; pre-2022 municipality rows use 2022 boundaries without a split/merge concordance.

visual_layers.notes: The source category label is Sem religião.
